2123885395033100559.en_summary: BREAKING: Nvidia, $NVDA, ends the week down 23% in its biggest weekly decline since October 2008. The stock erased $905 billion in market cap this week and officially closed down $2.88 trillion since October 6th. No comment from the company's board or interim CEO amid today's collapse.
